about_the_game:
There was a mansion where ghostly phenomena frequently occurred.

As an exorcist, you set foot in the mansion to quell these supernatural disturbances.

However, the spirits lurking within trap you inside.

The only way to escape is to calm all the ghostly occurrences.

Armed with protective talismans to suppress the phenomena and candles to pacify the spirits, you begin your search.

But the moment you place a talisman, the spirits start to resist...

Do not overlook any ghostly phenomena.

When you find one, place a talisman and light the entrance candle.

If no phenomena are present, light the candle without placing a talisman.

Calm all seven ghostly phenomena without making a single mistake.

Return safely, no matter what.

About "Reioku"

Reioku is a horror game in the "Exit 8 Like" genre, where players must pacify all ghostly phenomena within the mansion and find a way to escape.

Genre: Jumpscare-based "Exit 8 Like" horror

Playtime: Approximately 45–120 minutes

Controls: Keyboard & Mouse (Controller not supported)

Endings: 1

Difficulty: Low to Medium

Warnings

This game contains sudden scares and loud noises. Do not play if you are under elementary school age or have a weak heart.

If a child under elementary school age wishes to play, parental permission is required.

If you feel unwell during gameplay, stop playing immediately.

Streaming Guidelines

・Anyone, including individuals, corporations, and groups, may stream the game without prior permission.

・Estimated streaming time: 60–150 minutes (may vary based on play style, difficulty, and probability-based events).

・Monetization is only allowed for live or narrated gameplay.

・Uploading raw gameplay footage without commentary for monetization is prohibited.

[Mandatory]

・You or your audience must purchase the game before streaming or reviewing it.

・Include the word "Reioku" somewhere in your video title.

・Add the creator’s X account or the game’s store URL in the video description.

[Optional]

・If you enjoy the game, consider following the creator on X.

Important Notices

・The creator is not responsible for any damages or issues caused by playing or streaming this game.

・The game contains horror elements. Ensure you are in good physical condition before streaming.

・These guidelines may be updated without notice.
